title: Python requirement pinned across an epoch boundary
description: requirements.txt declares a pin that includes a PEP 440 epoch (`N!`). Epochs exist to override version ordering, so the pinned version can sort above later upstream releases and hide an upgrade the project needs.
remediation: Pin a version without an epoch, or document why the epoch is required.
limitation: It matches a pin that includes a PEP 440 epoch (`N!`) in the parsed requirements.txt; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
